About Elite Furniture

We are a family-run furniture studio in Chennai. Since 2008 we have built pieces from responsibly sourced teak, sheesham and oak, finished by hand and backed by a ten-year frame warranty.

18years of craft
12k+homes furnished
10 yrframe warranty

Every item is made to order in our workshop and checked by the same carpenters who built it. You can visit the showroom to feel the fabrics and wood grains before you buy, or order online and return within 15 days if it doesn’t suit your space.
